name: Omawin
author: Diogo Chaves
description: Windows, from the bar: start, connect to, pause and stop Omarchy's Windows VM from one glyph, tune its cores, RAM and disk, and keep its RDP login — without the Docker socket or the docker group.

barWidget.description: Omarchy's Windows VM in the bar: state by colour, with Start, Connect, Pause, Stop, its shape and its login.
